summary: Created beads issues: saad-new-06k (remove/replace placeholder EXAMPLE.astro content), saad-new-qc3 (replace placeholder social links in Navbar), saad-new-nnq (align global color tokens with design guide palette), saad-new-5en (fix README encoding artifacts).
Created complete dentist website with Navbar, Hero, Services, About, Testimonials, CTA, and Footer sections using frontend-design skill.
Established design system with color variables (ivory, sage, terracotta) and responsive layouts. All components feature smooth animations and hover effects.
Updated index.astro to integrate all components and added global CSS variables for consistent theming across the site.

Fixed typography consistency across all components (saad-new-kjj). Added Google Fonts @import to all 6 components (Services, About, Testimonials, CTA, Footer). Applied Manrope font to all body text elements, Plus Jakarta Sans to headings.
Consolidated Google Fonts @import statements into BaseLayout and removed per-component imports.
Added MCP server usage instructions to AGENTS.md.
Expanded AGENTS.md MCP section to list available servers and usage steps.
Added sequential-thinking and playwright to MCP list in AGENTS.md.
Added quick MCP usage examples to AGENTS.md.
Created a design guide that documents the current visual system, tokens, and component patterns in docs/design-guide.md.
Applied BaseLayout to index.astro and added layout props to control navbar and main padding.
Centralized design tokens in global.css and replaced hardcoded palette values with CSS variables across components.
Restored global.css design tokens and nav palette so components render correct colors and contrast.
Created SectionHeader Astro component for repeated section headers and updated Services/Testimonials to use it; noted no shared button component due to divergent styles.
Adjusted hero mobile layout so text content appears before the visual on small screens.
